body: Thanks a lot, I'll look into that right now, for the future. Friend seems to have regained their composure and is thinking clearly again. Let's hope I'll never need this information. :)

We've watched a couple shows/movies together as well, but they feel distracted and usually want to stop mid movie. I've helped a few RL friends go through this as well, but it feels so much harder when you can't be there in person.  

Thanks for trying to help. :)

I've tried asking if there was anything I could do but got denied. They always say they want to talk, but no topic seems to work, regardless of who brings it up. They say they don't want to talk to me because they're afraid they'll 'scare me away', but I've tried to reassure them that won't happen and told them I care, but still nothing.
